description: This file contains unit tests for file handle safe reading functions, specifically testing reading until end and reading up to a specified count, handling both open and closed file handles within a test suite.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test methods for verifying safe read operations on file handles.

methods.name: read to end safely returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading to the end from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a count from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: read to end safely reads pipe contents
methods.description: Verifies that reading to the end of a pipe returns the correct data written to it.

methods.name: read safely up to count reads incrementally
methods.description: Tests that reading with a specified count reads data incrementally from the pipe.
